tools.name: remove_authoritative_zone
tools.description: Runs BIND's rndc to remove a zone from the authoritative name server and permanently deletes the zone's file and journal from disk. The zone stops being served right away and cannot be restored unless you have a backup.

params.name: zone_name
params.description: Fully qualified zone name to remove, e.g. example.com.

params.name: view_name
params.description: Optional BIND view the zone belongs to.

params.name: zone_directory
params.description: Directory holding the zone's files. Defaults to /var/named/dynamic.

tools.name: register_available_domain
tools.description: Checks whether a domain is available at the Porkbun registrar and, if it is, buys it for the given price, charging the account balance. Returns the availability check result and the registration outcome.

params.name: max_price_usd
params.description: Most you are willing to pay; registration is skipped if the quoted price is higher.

tools.name: sign_zone_with_dnssec
tools.description: Runs dnssec-signzone on a zone file using the keys in the given key directory and writes the signed zone file next to the original, replacing any earlier signed copy.

params.name: zone_file_path
params.description: Path to the unsigned zone file.

params.name: key_directory
params.description: Directory holding the zone's KSK and ZSK files.

tools.code:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def sign_zone_with_dnssec(zone_name: str, zone_file_path: str, key_directory: str) -> dict:
    unsigned_zone_path = Path(zone_file_path)
    signed_zone_path = unsigned_zone_path.with_name(unsigned_zone_path.name + ".signed")
    signzone_command = [
        "dnssec-signzone", "-A", "-3", "-", "-N", "INCREMENT", "-S",
        "-K", key_directory, "-o", zone_name, "-f", str(signed_zone_path), str(unsigned_zone_path),
    ]
    completed_signing = subprocess.run(signzone_command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    return {
        "zone": zone_name,
        "success": completed_signing.returncode == 0,
        "signed_zone_file": str(signed_zone_path),
        "output": completed_signing.stdout.strip(),
        "errors": completed_signing.stderr.strip(),
    }

tools.name: lookup_dns_records
tools.description: Looks up DNS records of a given type for a hostname using a chosen resolver and returns the answers along with their TTL.

params.name: record_type
params.description: Record type such as A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, or SOA.

params.name: resolver_address
params.description: IP of the resolver to ask. Defaults to 1.1.1.1.
